title: Best of Bali with Ubud and Kuta
alt: Rice terraces above Ubud in central Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani and Bedugul
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: A full day with your own car and guide: coffee plantation tasting, the Tegalalang rice terraces, Tegenungan waterfall and the Bali jungle swing.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: North to the Handara gate and Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple that sits on the lake, then the sea temple at Tanah Lot for sunset.

activities.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
activities.description: A sanctuary of banyan trees, moss covered shrines and several hundred long tailed macaques, ten minutes on foot from the Ubud market.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights in the green heart of Bali, with temple mornings, a coffee plantation on the way to Kintamani and lake country to the north.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Serangan Island and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Bali Safari and Marine Park
activities.description: Jungle Hopper entry to Bali Safari and Marine Park, with a safari ride through the African and Indian enclosures, animal shows and the water park.

activities.name: Water sports and Serangan Island
activities.description: Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at Tanjung Benoa, then a boat across to Serangan Island and its turtle conservation centre.

activities.name: Uluwatu and Padang Padang beach
activities.description: A half day along the southern cliffs: Padang Padang beach between its limestone walls, then Uluwatu temple as the sun drops into the ocean.

activities.name: Kuta beach and Kuta Square
activities.description: Bali's best known surf beach with boards for hire and beginner lessons, and the shops and cafes of Kuta Square two streets back.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Four nights on the south coast with a safari park day, water sports at Tanjung Benoa, the cliffs of Uluwatu and a free day on the beach.

day_titles.4: Bali Safari and on to Kuta

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
Rest of the day free in Bali's green interior
Optional: the Monkey Forest, the art market or the water palace
2: Breakfast at the hotel, then a full day tour with your own guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the road up to Kintamani
Views across Mount Batur and its crater lake
Tegenungan waterfall, Tegalalang rice terrace and the jungle swing
3: Breakfast, then north to the Handara gate for photographs
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Evening back in Ubud at your own pace
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer towards Kuta
Jungle Hopper entry at Bali Safari and Marine Park
Safari ride, animal shows and the water park
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
5: Breakfast, then private transfer to Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at the water sports club
Boat across to Serangan Island and the turtle centre
Back in Kuta for the evening
6: Breakfast, then a half day along the southern cliffs
Padang Padang beach, framed by limestone walls
Uluwatu temple at sunset, high above the ocean
Optional: the Kecak fire dance in the temple amphitheatre
7: Breakfast and a full day free on the coast
Optional: a surf lesson with an instructor on Kuta beach
Optional: shopping at Kuta Square or the night market
Optional: Waterbom park or a Balinese spa afternoon
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Give Ubud the first three nights. The island slows you down there, and the coast feels like a reward afterwards.
expert.tip: Leave Uluwatu for late afternoon and buy Kecak tickets as you arrive. The show starts as the sun sets and the amphitheatre fills quickly, so being early gets you a seat facing the ocean.

summary: Eight days across the two sides of Bali: three nights in Ubud for rice terraces, crater lakes and temple sunsets, then four nights in Kuta with a safari park day, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and the cliffs of Uluwatu.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace day tour; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; Bali Safari Jungle Hopper entry; water sports and Serangan Island; Uluwatu and Padang Padang tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
